content.text:
Enjoy stunning river and marina views from this renovated 2bdrm apartment, just a 3-min walk to Lagos historic centre and 5 mins to beaches.

Perfectly located to enjoy Lagos’ restaurants, shops, nightlife, and beautiful Algarve beaches, this apartment combines comfort, convenience, and spectacular views for an unforgettable stay.

This bright 90 m² apartment combines comfort, style, and unbeatable location.

Features

* Living room with balcony overlooking the river, Marina, and main avenue

* 2 bedrooms with hotel quality beds, scenic views

* Fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher and cooking essentials

* Laundry machine & dryer, plus outdoor patio for clothes or surfboards

* Air conditioning with heating in all rooms

* Soundproof windows with automatic blackout blinds

* Cable TV with international channels & Netflix

* High-speed WiFi

* Bed linen, towels, quality brand hand soap, toilet paper, hairdryer provided


Perfect Location

* Historic Lagos centre 3-min walk: restaurants, shops, and Marina

* Beautiful beaches within 5-10min walk

* Close to activities: boat trips, golf, kayaking, surfing, kitesurfing, windsurfing, and sightseeing


Family-Friendly & Extras

* Free baby cot and high chair available (upon request)

* Parking next to the building (some free)

* Bike and car rental nearby, plus bus stop

* Grocery stores, cafés, and restaurants within a few minutes’ walk

* Personalized phone contact for any questions before or during your stay

This apartment offers a prime riverside location, modern comfort, and easy access to Lagos’ beaches and attractions, perfect for couples, families, or friends seeking a memorable Algarve stay.
Quiet time after 10pm. No guests, parties or external services allowed (we offer extra services, please see house manual).
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
